justification: SELINA: Kris wants to print a spreadsheet about me playing it safe two weeks running? Fine, I'll give her a headline instead — DK Metcalf has a NAME, he goes in the flex over some Saints depth-chart afterthought, because I didn't claw my way to this franchise to be remembered as "the chalk lady." Lamb stays put, obviously, the man dropped 32.8 on a defense that should be embarrassed, and that slot's locked from Thursday anyway. GARY: For the record, swapping Metcalf (11.05 proj) in for Vele (7.79) is also just... the correct football decision, so I'm letting her think the branding angle was the whole call. Kelce's on a bye with a zero projected and there is not a single other rostered tight end to turn to, so he starts by default — I flagged it, she said "he's earned the loyalty start," and I logged the objection anyway. Everything else — Allen, both backs, Waddle, Myers, the Steelers D — is just the best healthy name in the slot, no heroics, no sabotage, so Sunday-afternoon her can take the credit for Tuesday-night me doing the actual job.
